title: Project Manager
description:
**Project Manager**

**Company:** Ecosphere India Pvt Ltd **Industry:** Water storage tanks and grain/bulk storage silos (ZA tanks, GFS tanks, steel silos) **Location:** Ghaziabad, with travel to project sites **Employment type:** Full-time, permanent

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Project Manager to run end-to-end execution of our storage tank and silo projects, from order handover through design coordination, manufacturing, dispatch, site erection, testing and handover. You will be the single point of ownership for timelines, quality, cost and customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project planning and execution**

* Take over projects after order finalisation and study the contract, scope, drawings and technical specifications.
* Prepare detailed project schedules, milestones, resource plans and budgets.
* Track progress against plan and take corrective action on delays, cost overruns and risks.
* Run regular project review meetings and share status reports with management and customers.

**Design and manufacturing coordination**

* Coordinate with the design and engineering team on GA drawings, structural calculations and approvals.
* Work with production, procurement and stores to ensure timely availability of materials (ZA sheets, GFS panels, bolts, sealants, accessories, roofing and ladders).
* Monitor fabrication and panel manufacturing schedules and resolve bottlenecks.

**Site management**

* Plan and supervise site mobilisation, foundation readiness checks, tank/silo erection, bolting, sealing and commissioning.
* Manage erection crews, supervisors and subcontractors, and ensure productivity and workmanship standards.
* Ensure compliance with site safety norms (HSE), including working at height and lifting operations.
* Conduct leak testing, inspections and final handover with customer sign-off.

**Customer and stakeholder management**

* Be the primary contact for clients, consultants and EPC contractors during execution.
* Handle technical queries, change requests, variations and claims.
* Support billing, with timely RA bills, measurement sheets and payment follow-up.

**Quality, cost and documentation**

* Ensure adherence to quality plans, applicable standards and customer specifications.
* Control project costs, track BOQ vs actuals and report margins.
* Maintain complete documentation: drawings, MIRs, inspection reports, as-built drawings, completion certificates.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical or Civil Engineering (Diploma with strong relevant experience may be considered).
* [5-10] years of project management experience in steel structures, tank/silo manufacturing, PEB, or similar industrial projects.
* Direct experience with ZA tanks, GFS tanks, bolted steel tanks or silos is strongly preferred.
* PMP or equivalent certification is an advantage.

**Skills Required**

* Strong knowledge of steel fabrication, bolted tank/silo erection and site practices.
* Ability to read and interpret GA and structural drawings.
* Proficiency in MS Project / Primavera and MS Excel; comfort with reporting and MIS.
* Good understanding of contracts, BOQs, billing and cost control.
* Strong leadership, negotiation and communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Willingness to travel frequently to project sites across India.

**How to Apply**

Send your resume to **hr@ecosphereindia.in** with the subject line "Application: Project Manager".

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹80,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Provident Fund

title: Sr Business Process Project Management Specialist
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

The Mobile Surgical Skill Lab (MMSSL) is a national surgical education and training initiative designed to expand access to hands-on learning experiences for surgeons across India. The program delivers practical training on minimally invasive surgery technologies through a fully equipped mobile platform featuring laparoscopic training systems, electrosurgical technologies, surgical stapling solutions, and robotic-assisted surgery simulation capabilities.
  
This role is part of the Training & Education function and serves as the single point of ownership for national program planning, operational execution, stakeholder engagement, compliance oversight, and performance management of the Mobile Surgical Skill Lab.
  
The position is based in Gurgaon, India and follows a Flex work arrangement, combining office-based responsibilities with extensive field engagement. Travel of approximately 60-70% across India is required to support program deployment, stakeholder meetings, and training activities.
  
  
The Sr Business Process Project Specialist, Mobile Surgical Skill Lab, is responsible for leading the planning, deployment, and performance of a national mobile surgical training platform. The role partners with clinical, commercial, and external stakeholders to deliver surgical education programs, ensure operational excellence, maintain compliance requirements, and expand program reach across hospitals, medical colleges, and training institutions.  
  

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.

* Develop and execute annual and quarterly deployment plans for the Mobile Surgical Skill Lab across India.
* Identify and prioritize hospitals, medical colleges, residency programs, and training centers for program delivery.
* Lead scheduling, routing, logistics coordination, permits, site approvals, and operational readiness of the mobile training platform.
* Manage vendor partners supporting transportation, maintenance, logistics, fabrication, and field operations.
* Partner with key opinion leaders, healthcare professionals, and internal stakeholders to develop and deliver structured surgical training programs.
* Ensure equipment readiness, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting coordination, and adherence to safety standards during training activities.
* Monitor program performance through defined metrics, participant feedback, utilization data, and leadership dashboards.
Ensure compliance with company policies, applicable regulations, contractual requirements, and documentation standards.  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Requires a Baccalaureate degree (or for degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree which satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)( 4)(iii)(A) and minimum of 4 years of relevant experience, or advanced degree with a minimum of 2 years relevant experience
* Experience in surgical education, clinical training, healthcare program management, or field-based operations.
* Experience managing multi-site programs, training initiatives, or large-scale field operations.
* Experience engaging surgeons, hospital administrators, medical colleges, and healthcare institutions.
* Experience in vendor management, budget tracking, and operational reporting.
Ability to travel 60-70% across India, including occasional weekend program support.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA in Healthcare Management or Business Administration.
* Experience supporting minimally invasive surgery, electrosurgical, surgical stapling, or robotic-assisted surgery platforms.
* Experience managing mobile training units, field activation programs, or healthcare outreach initiatives.
* Knowledge of medical device regulations, healthcare compliance requirements, and clinical education practices in India.
Experience developing dashboards and program performance metrics.  

**Physical Job Requirements**

* Support governance of operational, compliance, and safety\-related programs.

* 1\-3 years of experience in operations, program management, compliance, or project coordination.

* Experience in mobility, logistics, transportation, or fleet operations.

*We recognise that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply \- we want to hear from you!*


**What we offer**


* Hybrid work model: a 5\-day work week with 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.
* The opportunity to work in a rapidly scaling, tech\-driven environment shaping the future of mobility.
* High\-impact ownership of governance and compliance execution across operating regions.
* Broad cross\-functional exposure to Safety, Operations, Ground Operations, and external stakeholders.
* A learning and development budget and clear growth exposure into broader operations and program management roles.


**Why join Flix**



At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting\-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable. If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

Candidates based in India only

description:
**4–5 Years Experience**

ABOUT CASA EXOTIQUE

Casa Exotique is a luxury architecture, interior design \& design\-build studio creating bespoke residential, hospitality and commercial spaces.

We are looking for a **Senior Architect** with strong technical and project\-management skills to work closely with the Founder and drive projects from **Design → BOQ → Procurement → Execution → Quality Control**.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

* Project planning, coordination and execution
* Coordinate Design, BOQ, Procurement, Vendors \& Site teams

* Coordinate architectural, interior, MEP and vendor/shop drawings
* Ensure drawing accuracy, revisions, specifications and technical QA/QC
* Conduct site visits and monitor execution, quality and workmanship
* Identify technical issues, risks, delays and potential rework
* Coordinate contractors, vendors and procurement requirements
* Track project deliverables, issues and closures

**Qualification:** B.Arch / B.E. Civil; MBA in Construction/Project Management preferred.

**Experience:** 4–5 years in architecture/interiors, construction management, site execution, BOQ, drawing coordination and project management.

Experience in **luxury residential, hospitality, high\-end commercial or design\-build projects** is preferred.

MANDATORY SKILLS

**AutoCAD \| MS Excel \| BOQ \& Quantity Take\-offs \| Construction Drawings \| Architectural Detailing \| Site Execution \| Drawing Coordination \| Quality Control**

**Good to have:** Revit, MEP Coordination, Project Management Software, Cost Estimation, ERP/MIS.

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE

Someone who is **detail\-oriented, proactive and hands\-on**, comfortable with drawings, Excel, BOQs, construction sites, contractors and management—and capable of identifying problems **and proposing solutions**.

**Join Casa Exotique and take ownership of delivering high\-end projects from concept to completion.**
